contents.text: Good evening, and you're up late, but a practice that runs on paperwork is exactly where an agent earns its keep! Yes, this is a custom agent: it reads your clients' invoices and your bank statements, and it proposes the matches each month. It only sends or changes anything after you say yes, and it works from your files or your accounting package, which we'd look at together.

arguments.question: How do you match them now, and what would you like it to take off your plate?

choices.label: Tell me how we do it now
choices.why: I'll pass it to Louis, who will shape the agent around your practice.

choices.label: Show me a custom agent at work
choices.why: See how one reads files, shows its work and asks before it sends.

choices.label: Have Louis call me
choices.why: A short call, then he quotes it. Every quote is his, after that call.
